name: schema-org-mcp

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Get server version, build info, and runtime fingerprint. Use this to verify which version is deployed.

tools.name: server_stats
tools.description: Get server performance statistics including cache hit rates, tool invocation counts, and timing.

tools.name: get_schema_type
tools.description: Get detailed information about a schema.org type including description, parent types, and documentation URL

typeName.description: The name of the schema.org type (e.g., "Person", "Organization", "Article", "Event"). Supports fuzzy matching for typos.

tools.name: search_schemas
tools.description: Search for schema.org types by keyword. Searches type names and descriptions.

query.description: Search query to find relevant schema types (e.g., "business", "event", "product")

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: get_type_hierarchy
tools.description: Get the inheritance hierarchy for a schema.org type, showing parent types and child types

typeName.description: The name of the schema.org type

tools.name: get_type_properties
tools.description: Get all properties available for a schema.org type, with expected value types. Supports filtering by mode, pagination, and deprecation status.

typeName.description: The name of the schema.org type

mode.description: Filter mode: all (default), direct (only this type), inherited (only from parent types)

limit.description: Maximum number of properties to return

tools.name: generate_example
tools.description: Generate a comprehensive JSON-LD example for a schema.org type with realistic sample data

typeName.description: The name of the schema.org type

style.description: Example detail level: minimal (just required), standard (common properties), comprehensive (many properties)

customProperties.description: Custom property values to include in the example

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific schema.org property

propertyName.description: The name of the property (e.g., "name", "address", "offers"). Supports fuzzy matching.

tools.name: get_enumeration_values
tools.description: Get all valid values for a schema.org enumeration type (e.g., DayOfWeek, EventStatusType)

enumerationType.description: The name of the enumeration type

tools.name: validate_jsonld
tools.description: Validate a JSON-LD object against schema.org vocabulary. Checks types, properties, and expected value types.

tools.name: get_related_types
tools.description: Find types related to a given type through properties (types that can be values of its properties, or types that have properties pointing to it)

typeName.description: The name of the schema.org type

tools.name: get_multiple_types
tools.description: Get information about multiple schema.org types in a single call. Useful for comparison or bulk lookups.

typeNames.description: Array of type names to retrieve (e.g., ["Person", "Organization", "LocalBusiness"])

tools.name: compare_types
tools.description: Compare 2-5 schema.org types side by side. Shows shared properties, unique properties, and recommendations for when to use each.

typeNames.description: Array of 2-5 type names to compare (e.g., ["Article", "BlogPosting", "NewsArticle"])

tools.name: validate_jsonld_batch
tools.description: Validate multiple JSON-LD objects in a single call. Returns validation results for each object.

items.description: Array of JSON-LD objects to validate
